name: print-social-white-graphic-design-open-class-post-with-calendar-strip
title: Graphic Design Open Class with Calendar Strip
whatItIs: A white square post with a small OPEN CLASS label, a huge black condensed 'GRAPHIC DESIGN' with a tilted lime LEVEL 2 tag, a row of lime arrow buttons and outlined boxes reading 'At 4:00 PM' and 'Winter season', and a weekday strip of huge numerals 14, 15, 16 with a lime ellipse around the 15; below it the top of a dark green Monday Mission post with a grid and tick circles.
whatItMeans: Massive condensed type and a circled date give a class announcement instant clarity.
techniques: Weekday table with the target date circled
bestFor: Bold black and white with one accent

vocabulary.definition: A date marked with a hand-drawn ellipse.
Narrow letterforms allowing very large headlines.
An outlined rectangle holding a time or place.
